rule: The transactions beats 5 to 7 show. Set hash to the tx hash once it is on Base mainnet and render again; while hash is null the film shows a card labelled PLACEHOLDER. Before it shows a tx, the render reads its receipt and stops unless it matches expect: the event, the contract of deployments/README.md that emitted it, the vault's reason, the New York date, and for the early-close pair the side of the early close (etBefore: before that New York time; etFrom: at or after it).
